name: voice-aurora-wave
title: Voice Aurora Wave
description: Microphone amplitude is funnelled through a Framer Motion spring so erratic audio spikes become smooth, fluid breathing. Three counter-rotating conic-gradient layers with a 40px blur produce the aurora — animation runs strictly on transform & opacity.
author: Wensity <hello@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-cabinet, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif)

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/voice-aurora-wave.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add voice-aurora-wave.
